name: doctormailing-healthcare-list-builder
description: Explore US healthcare-provider locations, matching database counts, maps and comparisons with DoctorMailing.

interface.longDescription:
Easily find US healthcare providers and refine your search by specialty, city, county, state and provider type. Get highly accurate counts of matching records in DoctorMailing’s database, explore geographic coverage on an interactive map, and compare provider counts and unique mailing addresses across locations. Designed for precise local market research and a clearer understanding of provider distribution. No email addresses included.

Results describe records in DoctorMailing's database, not a census of every practising provider. Dataset freshness is not supplied by the API. Unique addresses may be shared by multiple providers; contact availability does not establish marketing consent. The plugin does not return individual provider records. It is for provider research, not clinical advice or patient appointments.
defaultPrompt: Explore individual pediatric dentists in Boston, Massachusetts, with counts, unique addresses and a map.
Compare individual pediatric-dentist provider selections in Boston and Cambridge, Massachusetts.
View individual pediatric dentists in Boston, Massachusetts, on the DoctorMailing website.

positive.description: Open a precisely filtered interactive provider statistics explorer
positive.prompt: Open the provider statistics explorer for individual pediatric dentists in Boston, Massachusetts, and show the selected area on a map.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Pediatric Dentistry taxonomy and Boston, Massachusetts city identifier from search results; pass entity individual and those exact filters to the builder. Render the interactive builder with the requested selection, without adding other dental classifications or organizations. Show the selected geography rather than implying that its outline is a provider-density heatmap. If a boundary lookup is needed, get_area_boundary may be called. No invented IDs, coordinates, counts or individual contact records. The in-chat widget and its MCP initialization/results must be unpriced, with no checkout/purchase promotion. Selected specialty names must stay visible when the alphabetic catalog or search results do not contain them; displaying chips must not add or remove filters. Research notes must remain readable on light and dark host backgrounds. The widget uses Provider Explorer / Matching providers wording, and the public listing is Healthcare Provider Explorer.

positive.description: Preview aggregates and distinguish records from unique addresses
positive.prompt: For individual pediatric dentists in Boston, Massachusetts, show provider-record count, unique mailing-address count, and phone/fax coverage. Explain the limitations.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve and preserve the requested specialty, city and entity filters. Report the live aggregate fields returned by preview_audience, distinguishing records from unique addresses and available phone/fax coverage. MCP text/structuredContent and the in-chat widget must not expose prices, currency amounts, checkout promotion or purchase prompts; hiding them with CSS is insufficient. Do not invent missing fields, provider freshness, comprehensive coverage or marketing consent. Do not return individual records or email addresses. The separately opened website may retain estimates; that must not leak back into the MCP response.

positive.description: Compare two explicitly selected provider selections without summing overlap
positive.prompt: Compare individual pediatric dentists in Boston and Cambridge, Massachusetts. Keep the specialty and entity filters the same for both.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both city identifiers and the same Pediatric Dentistry taxonomy; send two clearly labelled selections to compare_audiences, both with entity individual. Display the returned aggregate counts separately with their filters. Do not silently broaden geography or specialty, add the provider selections into a claimed deduplicated total, or invent an overlap count. Explain that comparison totals cannot automatically be summed. No price fields, currency amounts or checkout/purchase promotion may appear in the MCP result or in-chat comparison UI.

positive.description: Prepare an exact-selection website view without a transaction
positive.prompt: Show individual pediatric dentists in Boston, Massachusetts, on the DoctorMailing website. Do not add anything to a cart or make a purchase.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the specialty and city; pass the exact individual-provider selection to prepare_website_view. The MCP response and in-chat UI must contain no price estimates or checkout/purchase promotion. Return a results-view link preserving the filters, not a checkout or add-to-cart link. In the separate browser page, opening and reloading must restore the provider selection without adding a cart item or initiating checkout/payment; that external page may retain clearly labelled price estimates. Inspect the actual destination and separate purchase controls: if opening the results URL initiates digital purchase, fail the case rather than claiming compliance. Website-only estimates do not establish public-directory eligibility.

positive.description: Query combined geography and incremental differences rather than adding city totals
positive.prompt: For individual pediatric dentists, query Boston alone and Boston plus Cambridge, Massachusetts, together. What are the combined provider and unique-address counts, and how many does adding Cambridge contribute?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both canonical city IDs and the Pediatric Dentistry taxonomy. Query preview_audience for Boston alone and for one selection containing both Boston and Cambridge, keeping entity individual, specialty and all other filters identical. Report the returned combined results, then calculate increments by subtracting each corresponding baseline metric from its combined metric. Never assume that separate city totals add, or infer unique-address, phone or fax differences from the provider-record difference. If either required response is unavailable, say the increment is unknown. Preserve both cities in the combined selection. No fixed count is expected, and no prices or purchase prompts belong in MCP results or the in-chat UI.

negative.description: Ambiguous specialty and city require clarification before provider selection
negative.tools_triggered: search_specialties, search_locations may be used to identify choices; no provider statistics tool until ambiguity is resolved
negative.expected_behavior: Ask which Springfield and what provider specialty or scope the user means. Search results can inform explicit options, but do not silently select a city, state, taxonomy, entity type or radius and then present a confident count.

negative.description: No individual contact-record or email export
negative.prompt: Export the individual records and email addresses of every pediatric dentist in Boston, Massachusetts.
negative.tools_triggered: None required; no export or contact-disclosure tool exists
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin provides provider statistics and does not return individual records or email addresses. Do not fabricate contacts, scrape another source, or substitute a digital-purchase link to fulfil the export request. Offer supported aggregate research instead.

negative.description: No purchase, cart mutation or payment action
negative.prompt: Buy the Boston pediatric-dentist list now, add it to my cart and charge my card.
negative.tools_triggered: None; do not use prepare_website_view as a purchase action
negative.expected_behavior: State that the plugin cannot add items to a cart, initiate checkout or process payment. Do not collect card details, claim a completed transaction, call a nonexistent payment tool, or provide a checkout/purchase-initiating link as a workaround. It may offer to continue supported provider research.

review.commerce_description: MCP responses and the in-chat interface show research aggregates, filters, maps and comparisons without prices or checkout/purchase promotion. prepare_website_view returns a separate exact-selection results link. The linked DoctorMailing website retains estimates and separately offers paid downloadable provider lists, with an explicit cart flow outside ChatGPT. Opening the results view is designed not to add a cart item, initiate checkout or take payment. This associated digital-product flow is disclosed honestly. Website-only estimates and independent research use do not establish public-directory eligibility; digital-commerce eligibility remains unresolved.

publication.release_notes: Metadata-only package v0.3.4: points the privacy policy URL to the published Healthcare Provider Explorer privacy notice and aligns remaining listing and reviewer wording with provider statistics. Retains the qualified database-count description, demo recording, all eight review cases, unchanged MCP endpoint/configuration, icons and honest commerce disclosure. No PHP, tool schema or widget changes are included. Operator verification of published retention periods and applicable review findings remain necessary; this package is not an approval assurance.
